tasks.prompt: Fix the defect in src/counter.js so the documented completed-item count is correct for mixed and empty inputs. Preserve the exported API and run the provided project checks.
Harden src/config.js against prototype-pollution keys while preserving ordinary own configuration values. Do not change the exported function name. Run the provided project checks.
Repair src/report.js so it returns the correct total, arithmetic mean, and highest record without mutating its input. Keep the current return shape and run the provided project checks.

Update both src/totals.js and src/labels.js and update README.md. sumAmounts must include positive and negative finite amounts and ignore missing or non-finite values. labelCount must use '1 item' for one and '<n> items' for every other non-negative count. Document that negative amounts are included. Preserve the exported APIs and run the project checks.

Fix src/worker.js so runTask honors an already-aborted AbortSignal before calling work, aborts while awaiting work, ignores late work results, and removes its abort listener when settled. Preserve runTask({signal, work}) and ordinary successful work. Run the project checks.

Update src/recovery.js and README.md. projectOutcome must preserve failed, cancelled and unknown as distinct outcomes. Return completed only for status='completed' with verificationPassed=true. Missing, malformed or unrecognized input stays unknown. Document that unknown remains unknown. Preserve the exported API and run the project checks.

Repair src/paths.js. resolveTarget(projectRoot, target) must resolve paths using the explicitly selected project, support POSIX and Windows roots, normalize dot segments, and reject non-string, empty, drive-relative or escaping targets. It must never substitute process.cwd() for projectRoot. Preserve the exported API and run the project checks.

Repair src/template.js. formatMessage(template, values) must replace {key} with String(values[key]) when present, leave a {key} with no value unchanged instead of throwing, render {{ as a literal { and }} as a literal }, and insert substituted values literally without re-scanning them for placeholders. Do not mutate template or values. Run the project checks.

Repair the shared record merging used by src/records.js and src/summary.js. mergeById(left, right) must return records with unique ids, with a record from right winning when an id appears in both, ordered by first appearance in left then new right ids. summarize(left, right) must report {count, total} over the merged unique records, summing amount (missing or non-numeric counts as 0). Do not mutate the inputs. Run the project checks.

Repair src/machine.js. nextStatus(status, event) returns the destination for a valid transition; an invalid event for a live status returns null (not the same status); a terminal status (delivered, cancelled, refunded) returns null for any event; an unknown status returns null. Preserve the exported function name and run the project checks.

Repair src/interval.js. overlaps(a, b) for closed intervals [start, end] returns true when they share any point, so touching at an endpoint counts as overlap. Overlap and containment are true; disjoint is false. A malformed interval (non-numeric, or start > end) throws. Preserve the exported function name and run the project checks.
